description: Add minimal renderer-side logging to src/v2/engine.ts to classify ISS-012 (stuck-EXPORTING) on next repro. Log ONLY: onCompleted receipt, onFailed receipt, onCancelled receipt, _isStaleExport verdict at receipt, v2State at receipt. Do NOT implement watchdogs, timeouts, or state machine changes. Scope: single file src/v2/engine.ts. Purpose: when ISS-012 next fires, these logs will prove whether export.completed reached the renderer and whether _isStaleExport discarded it. Required per T-035 verdict.md classification guidance. title: Add ISS-012 renderer completion logging to src/v2/engine.ts
